notes: synthetic: an ordinary day of nine stories, a cli release and a backend deploy, one blocked session, two branches

stories.headline: Webhook deliveries now retry for an hour before giving up
stories.dek: Partners whose servers blip no longer miss events: a failed delivery retries with backoff up to six times.

stories.headline: Daily digests arrive at 8am in each workspace's own timezone
stories.dek: Digests used to go out at 8am UTC, so most teams outside Europe read them a day late (#212).

stories.headline: The CLI no longer hangs when the network drops mid-upload
stories.dek: Uploads now time out after 30 seconds and resume from the last chunk.

stories.headline: Invoices are sorted by due date by default
stories.dek: The invoice table moved into its own component along the way, with no change in behavior.

stories.headline: Account activity can be exported as CSV
stories.dek: A new endpoint streams the last 90 days of activity for an account.

stories.headline: Sign-in keeps the email you typed after a failed attempt

blocked: Mobile push notifications wait on a new signing certificate

judge: the headline says what the day was about and names the cli 1.4.2 release, the standfirst makes no claim the stories do not support, the lead is the webhook retry or the digest timezone story, and housekeeping (s7, s8, s9) is in brief rather than the lead
